description: Create a new theme file in a Fudge draft, or with `replace` rewrite a whole file. New theme filenames include the draft’s file prefix, except templates, config and locales. Every sections/*.liquid file needs a {% schema %} with a non-empty "name".

content.description: The complete file content, without line gutters.

path.description: A theme file such as sections/main-product.liquid or templates/product.json, or a content document such as .entities/product/123.jsonc or .entities/page/45.body.html.

replace.description: True to replace an existing file you have read in full.

revision.description: The revision returned when this file was read, when replacing.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: write_draft_file
title: Write draft file
